items.title: 2. Negligible Volume of Gas Particles (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 2. Negligible Volume of Gas Particles: a main subheading of 6.1 Assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 119-119.

blocks.text: Ek ek molecule ka volume gas ke kul volume ke muqable mein bohat hi kam (negligible) hai. Is liye particles ko aise point masses mana jata hai jin ka apna koi khaas volume nahi.
